02The commercial problem

Hotels can invest in excellent spas, treatments, fitness, partners and facilities and still not have one wellness experience guests understand and choose.

Wellness is usually planned and managed by department. Each can hit its targets, but the guest doesn’t experience departments. They experience one stay, and one story told from discovery to departure.

05The framework

From a collection of amenities to one experience the hotel can sell.

Four stages over 90 days, with every department aligned.

01

Audit

What exists? We assess the current or planned wellness offer, guest journey, departmental delivery and communications.

02

Define

What is the one experience? A unified, differentiated wellness proposition, built around what the hotel can genuinely deliver, mapped from before arrival to after departure.

03

Align

How does everyone deliver it? A shared guest-experience framework for rooms, spa, F&B, fitness, front office and marketing, with clear handovers.

04

Activate

How does it drive revenue? The commercial opportunities, where to invest, the guest-facing story and an implementation roadmap with measurable priorities.

06How it works

A focused 90-day engagement. Ongoing support where needed.

The 90 days is the length of the engagement, not a countdown to opening. Pre‑opening properties can start many months ahead, then continue with us month by month through to launch.

We don’t run your wellness department. With or without a wellness director, we connect wellness to rooms, F&B, marketing and the commercial plan, so it drives revenue across the whole property.

First 90 days

Define and align: map the current or planned journey, find the gaps between departments, define the one experience, and align it with what marketing can credibly promise.

After 90 days

Optional ongoing strategic advisory, supporting leadership as the proposition develops.

Your teams deliver

ALT‑15° defines the strategy and commercial framework. The hotel’s own teams execute it, with a clear plan they can deliver.

The value

One experience guests understand, staff can deliver and the hotel can sell, so wellness lifts spend per guest, ancillary revenue and repeat stays.

What sets ALT‑15° apart

ALT‑15° brings together wellness expertise and commercial strategy, two disciplines that rarely work together closely enough in hospitality.

We don’t replace a hotel’s spa, clinical or operational specialists. We work alongside leadership to identify where wellness investment could deliver greater value, then define what to prioritise, who it’s for, and how to position, package, price and sell it.

So wellness becomes a compelling reason to choose the hotel, spend more during the stay and return.
